stem: The horizontal range of a projectile is R and the maximum height attained by it is H. A hollow vertical cylinder of radius r and height h has a smooth internal surface. A small particle is placed in contact with the inner side of the upper rim, at point A, and given a horizontal speed u, tangential to the rim. It leaves the lower rim at point B, vertically below A. If the total number of revolutions made by the particle inside the cylinder n is an integer, then: (a) (u/2πr)√(2h/g) = n (b) h/(2πr) = n (c) 2πr/h = n (d) u/√(2gh) = n

(Multiple correct) The displacement (x) of a particle depends on time (t) as x = αt² − βt³. (a) The particle will return to its starting point after time α/β. (b) The particle will come to rest after time 2α/3β. (c) The initial velocity of the particle was zero but its initial acceleration was not zero. (d) No net force will act on the particle at t = α/3β.
book_key: a, b, c, d (a) returns to the start after α/β · (b) comes to rest after 2α/3β · (c) initial velocity zero but initial acceleration not zero · (d) no net force at t = α/3β

stem: A particle of mass m falls from rest through a resistive medium having resistive force F = −kv, where v is the velocity of the particle and k is a constant.
